Maya P: heads-up: company all-hands Friday 9:00am PT. quick run-through: 1) Exec update & hiring snapshot (10m) 2) Policy briefing: hosted API retention + new PII scrub default (12m) 3) Dedicated capacity launch callouts + migration notes (10m) 4) Live Q&A and 5-min takeaways. please add Qs here.
Diego H: will we get a checklist for teams to audit their logging configs?
Maya P: yes — we'll publish a short "engineering checklist" slide and a follow-up doc with exact config changelogs.
Rina V: are customers notified about the retention change ahead of time? opt-in for Dedicated?
Owen K: ops update: Hosted will adopt 90-day rolling logs; Dedicated customers can opt into the same default or request custom retention via the console. we'll include the notification cadence (30/14/3 days).
Liam B: can we show the UI flow for the opt-in toggle in console during the call? that's helpful.
Owen K: yep — demo slide with the toggle + rollback instructions. also adding a migration window and backfill constraints.
Maya P: accessibility: we'll enable live captions and make the transcript downloadable. RecordingBot will post links after.
Diego H: any perf/billing implications for longer retention?
Owen K: no immediate rate changes for standard 90-day retention. custom retention >90 days will be a billable add-on; we'll include examples.
Rina V: Q for execs: hiring plan — will we prioritize infra/ops roles this quarter?
Maya P: short answer: yes, small prioritized hires for infra & reliability, plus a focus on platform engineers supporting Dedicated rollout. more detail in the exec update.
Diego H: request: could product include an "ops-ready" summary slide with callouts for SRE/infra on action items?
Maya P: good idea — adding a 2-bullet "Action items for engineering" summary (audit logs, toggle tests) that teams can forward.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled — All-Hands Fri 9:00am PT — reminders in 24h and 30m.
RecordingBot: recording + transcript will be uploaded to internal drive and linked here after the meeting (expect within ~1 hour).
Liam B: can we get the slides before the meeting for review?
Maya P: slides will be shared 2 hours before the all-hands and the follow-up doc within the hour after. drop any Qs here and we'll triage into the live Q&A. see you Friday! :raised_hands:
